people.name: Brett Favre
people.extract: Brett Lorenzo Favre is an American former professional football quarterback who played in the National Football League (NFL) for 20 seasons, primarily with the Green Bay Packers. Favre had 321 consecutive starts from 1992 to 2010, including 297 regular season games, the most in league history. He was also the first NFL quarterback to obtain 70,000 yards, 10,000 passes, 6,000 completions, 500 touchdowns, and victories over all 32 teams.
highlights: Played 20 NFL seasons, mostly with Green Bay Packers.
Holds NFL record for 321 consecutive starts.
First NFL QB with 70,000 yards, 500 touchdowns.

people.name: Julia Sweeney
people.extract: Julia Sweeney is an American actress and comedian. She gained fame as a cast member on the NBC sketch comedy series Saturday Night Live from 1990 to 1994. She played Mrs. Keeper in the film Stuart Little and voiced Brittany in Father of the Pride. She appeared in the Hulu series Shrill, the Showtime series Work in Progress, and the Starz series American Gods. Sweeney also had a recurring role on Frasier.
highlights: Cast member on Saturday Night Live (1990-1994).
Played Mrs. Keeper in the film Stuart Little.
Voiced Brittany in Father of the Pride.

people.name: Ryan Mathews (American football)
people.extract: Ryan Jefforey Mathews is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Fresno State Bulldogs, earning second-team All-American honors in 2009. Mathews was selected by the San Diego Chargers in the first round of the 2010 NFL draft with the 12th overall pick. He was named to the Pro Bowl in 2011. He also played for the Philadelphia Eagles.
highlights: Former NFL running back for Chargers and Eagles.
Second-team All-American at Fresno State in 2009.
Named to the Pro Bowl in 2011.
